text: Juan, a lazy man in his forties, idles through life in Cuba with his accident-prone sidekick Lazaro, until a corpse they catch while fishing [wakes and attacks them|threat|the dead that rise] and Lazaro kills it with [a spear gun|images|weapons and tools]. As people across the city start attacking each other at random, Juan suspects vampires or demons and opens a business killing zombified residents for a fee. The work strains his bond with [his daughter Camila|who_suffers|families and parents], and [every bite turns a friend|rules|it passes to others] as the dead overrun the streets.
